title: Laboratory plans let a self-driving database prepare for the workload of a two-dimensional materials laboratory network
description: Code, result files, figure scripts and figures for the paper "Laboratory plans let a self-driving database prepare for the workload of a two-dimensional materials laboratory network" (Data-Centric Engineering (Cambridge University Press)). Taylor D. Sparks acknowledges support from the U.S. National Science Foundation through the Programmable Cloud Laboratory (PCL) Test Bed AURORA, Award No. 2607535.
